name: lafayette-forks
description: Personal fork marketplace. Tracks upstream plugins with local patches applied, so updates are a deliberate merge rather than a silent fast-forward.

plugins.name: amazon
plugins.description: Amazon marketplace research across regional storefronts: verified price, stock, rating, seller and specs read from the listing rather than the search grid, delivery dates checked against the postcode they were rendered for. Fork of danielrosehill/Claude-Amazon-Plugin with Windows portability fixes applied.
